sentences.text: Vectisuchus is a genus of pholidosaurid mesoeucrocodylian, a type of crocodile-like reptile.
The type specimen, SMNS 50984, was discovered in 1977, and the genus was formally described in 1980.
The type species is V. leptognathus, and Vectisuchus belongs to the parent group Dyrosauroidea.

Fossils of this animal come from the Early Cretaceous-age Wealden Group of the Isle of Wight, England, where it lived between 125.77 and 119.57 million years ago during the Barremian to Aptian stages.
